author: Jen Judson
description: The US Army unveiled a new version of its iconic Abrams tank at the Detroit Auto Show in what it hopes will be an example of a new, more streamlined way of producing major new weapons systems.
title: Army Displays New Version of Abrams Tank at Detroit Auto Show

description: Retired General Wesley Clark, former NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe, discusses President Trump not imposing Greenland tariffs as the President suggests a framework deal between the US & NATO's Mark Rutte. General Clark also reacts to how the President spoke about NATO during his speech in Davos and what to expect as President Zelenskiy is set to speak with Trump Thursday. Retired General Wesley Clark speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Alliance Will Survive: Gen. Clark on Trump, NATO

author: Lydia Beyoud, Katy O'Donnell, Olga Kharif
description: A sweeping US crypto market bill is likely to be delayed by at least several weeks as key lawmakers shift their focus to potential housing legislation in support of President Donald Trump’s affordability push, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: Crypto Bill Delayed as Senate Panel Pivots to Trump Housing Push

author: Donato Paolo Mancini, Eric Martin
description: The State Department has instructed US diplomats to suggest President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace isn’t meant to replace the United Nations but is designed to complement it, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: US Seeks to Play Down Fears Around Trump’s Gaza Board of Peace

description: Rick Wurster, President and CEO of The Charles Schwab Corporation, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the firm's latest earnings report, adding that Schwab is "absolutely open" to adding a prediction market feature to its platform "within the context of an investment portfolio." Wurster says that at the moment, prediction markets aren't high on the list of client wants and needs, and also says that as trading and client volume remains robust, Schwab isn't seeing undue geopolitical concern from clients. Wurster speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Schwab CEO: 'Absolutely Open' to Event-Based Prediction Markets

description: Frank Luntz, Fil Inc. Founder & West Point Professor, states President Trump needs to empathize with the American public as campaigning begins for the 2026 Midterm elections. He also shares his reaction to the President's speech at Davos and if increasing his travel across the US will help the Republican party this fall. Frank speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Needs to Empathize With Public: Luntz on Midterms

author: Derek Wallbank
description: Russia’s President Vladimir Putin said he is ready to commit Russian assets that remain frozen in the US to rebuild Ukrainian regions damaged during the war after a peace treaty is concluded.
title: Putin Offers Frozen Russian Assets in US to Peace Board, Ukraine

author: James Mayger
description: Australia’s opposition coalition has collapsed following a dispute over support for the Labor government’s crackdown on hate speech, deepening the malaise of the two center-right parties following an election thrashing last year.
title: Australia’s Opposition Coalition Collapses Over Hate Speech Law

description: While speaking to reporters at the World Economic Forum in Davos, President Donald Trump spoke further about the "concept of a deal" associated with Greenland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says 'We Have the Concept of a Deal' With Greenland

author: Ike Swetlitz
description: CVS Health Corp. was accused by Republican lawmakers of possibly violating antitrust laws by discouraging independent pharmacies from working with third-party competitors.
title: CVS Health May Have Violated Antitrust Laws, Republican Lawmakers Say

author: Joe Sobczyk
description: The president retreats from use of military force or tariffs.
title: Trump Finds His Greenland Framework and Pulls Back Threats

author: Myles Miller
description: New York City is banning hidden hotel fees as a way to lower costs for visitors as the city prepares for an influx of tourists during the World Cup.
title: NYC Bans Hidden Hotel Fees Ahead of World Cup Tourist Influx

author: Oma Seddiq, Maggie Eastland
description: Congress is one step closer to gaining the authority to review artificial intelligence chip sales to China, a move likely to open a rift with the Trump administration over plans to let Nvidia Corp. sell its powerful H200 processors to the world’s second-largest economy.
title: House Seeks Say Over AI Chip Sales After Nvidia’s China Win

description:
On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Bloomberg Opinion's Marc Champion about President Trump’s 'America First' Davos speech as his Greenland announcements roil Europe and cause market whipsaw.
Then, Jennifer Welch of Bloomberg Economics weighs in on how the European Union is reacting to Trump's moves. Then, Charles Schwab CEO Rick Wurster joins to recap earnings as the firm saw trading swell in its most recent quarter. Plus, Bloomberg International Economics & Policy Correspondent Michael McKee discusses the future of the Federal Reserve as President Trump says his announcement about his chair pick could come soon. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Backs Off Greenland Tariffs, Citing ‘Framework’ Deal | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 1/21/2026

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump suggested that Jerome Powell would not enjoy his tenure if he stayed on the Federal Reserve’s Board of Governors after his term as chair expired, in the latest broadside against the central bank chief.
title: Trump Warns Powell Won’t Be ‘Very Happy’ If He Stays on at Fed

author: Mikella Schuettler, Chris Dolmetsch
description: The Trump administration won a temporary reprieve in a lawsuit over the Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency’s tactics in Minnesota when an appellate court put on hold a ruling restricting officers from interfering with protesters in the state.
title: Trump Wins Delay on Order Restricting ICE Tactics in Minnesota

author: Greg Ryan
description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement launched an operation in Maine this week, targeting another state with a significant Somali population following a surge in deportation activity and protests in Minnesota.
title: ICE Launches Enforcement Push in Maine’s Biggest Cities

description: President Donald Trump says the "framework for a future deal" on Greenland has been reached, so he won't be imposing additional tariffs on Europe. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says 'Framework' of Deal for Greenland Is Done

author: Lucille Liu
description: China’s Vice Premier He Lifeng met with a coterie of top global executives at the World Economic Forum in Davos, according to a person familiar with the matter — maintaining his nation’s international outreach amid fears of trade and financial fragmentation.
title: China Vice Premier Meets Dimon, Cook, Dalio, Other CEOs in Davos

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Joe Mathieu discusses President Donald Trump's address to the World Economic Forum. On today's show, Former Federal Reserve Vice Chair Lael Brainard, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and State Department Principal Deputy Spokesperson Tommy Pigott. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Seeks Greenland Negotiations at Davos | Balance of Power: Early Edition 1/21/2026

description:
Tommy Pigott, deputy spokesperson for the US State Department, said that the US push for control of Greenland is about stronger national security partnership for both the US and NATO. 
Earlier today President Trump called out NATO allies over control of Greenland, saying that the US is the only country who can protect Greenland and telling Denmark about negotiations, 'you can say yes, and we will be very appreciative, or you can say no, and we will remember.' Pigott also discussed the status of peace talks between Russia and Ukraine, saying that it is up to 'both sides' to come to an agreement on a settlement.   (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Greenland Push About 'Stronger NATO, Stronger Europe,' Says State Dept. Spokesperson

author: Melissa Shin
description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and automotive industry leaders doubled down on their opposition to Canada’s trade truce with China, warning that opening the door to Chinese electric vehicles and auto investment risks gutting the Canadian sector.
title: Ontario’s Ford Rallies Auto Sector to Reject Carney’s China EV Deal

author: Hadriana Lowenkron, Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: President Donald Trump said he would refrain from imposing tariffs on goods from European nations opposing his effort to take possession of Greenland, citing a “framework of a future deal” he was reached regarding the island.
title: Trump Backs Off Greenland Tariffs, Citing ‘Framework’ Deal

description: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chair Lael Brainard said the move to criminally investigate Fed Chair Jerome Powell was a "spectacular misstep" by the Trump administration has set off alarm bells in markets and in Congress.  Brainard also discussed future of fed independence as the Supreme Court heard arguments in the case of the firing of Fed governor Lisa Cook. Brainard said that the case is crucial to maintaining a 'fundamental bedrock of the American economic dynamism.'   (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Cook Supreme Court Case Could Challenge 'Fundamental Bedrock' of Economy, Says Brainard

author: Donato Paolo Mancini
description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said she won’t immediately sign onto President Donald Trump’s “Board of Peace” charter, signaling that doing so would create legal risks.
title: Meloni Says Italy Won’t Immediately Join Trump’s Peace Project

description:
Dutch Prime Minister Dick Schoof says threats of more tariffs from the Trump administration are "unjustified."
Schoof is pushing for a diplomatic solution to resolve the dispute over Greenland. He speaks to Annmarie Hordern at the World Economic Forum in Davos. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Dutch PM Says Trump Tariff Threats Are 'Unjustified'

author: Alex Harris
description: A key question is emerging as investors await President Donald Trump’s nominee as the next Federal Reserve chair — how the candidate will manage the central bank’s $6.6 trillion balance sheet.
title: Fed’s Balance Sheet Is Point of Tension as Trump Weighs Chair

author: Aashna Shah
description: Maryland Governor Wes Moore proposed a $70.8 billion budget without new taxes or fees for the fiscal year beginning in July, pitching the plan as a way to stabilize the state’s economy after a turbulent year of federal funding cuts and job losses.
title: Maryland’s Moore Pitches $70.8 Billion Budget After Federal Cuts

description: President Trump spoke during meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte in Davos, saying he will discuss Greenland with Rutte. Trump also said the Danish foreign minister has not told him directly that Denmark rejects his offer to negotiate the US acquisition of Greenland.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He Will Discuss Greenland With NATO Chief Rutte

author: Eliyahu Kamisher
description: California Governor Gavin Newsom said he was denied entry to an event at the World Economic Forum in Davos after pressure from the White House, escalating a fight between President Donald Trump and one of his most prominent Democratic critics.
title: Newsom Says White House Barred Him From Davos Event

author: Marcelo Rochabrun, Matthew Bristow
description: Peruvian lawmakers have introduced two motions that could lead to the ouster of interim President Jose Jerí who has been in office for just three months.
title: Peru Lawmakers Present Two Motions That Could Oust President

author: Stephan Kueffner, Oscar Medina
description: President Daniel Noboa slapped a 30% punitive duty on imports from Ecuador’s northern neighbor, Colombia, to push its government toward a “real commitment” on border control.
title: Ecuador Hits Colombia With 30% Tariffs, Citing Narco-Trafficking

author: Kelcee Griffis
description: The Federal Communications Commission told broadcasters on Wednesday that talk shows and late-night programs hosting political candidates must offer their opponents equal time, an effort aimed at balancing TV airwaves seen as hyper-partisan.
title: Talk Shows That Feature Candidates Must Welcome Rivals, FCC Says

description:
President Donald Trump upped the pressure on Europe to cede control of Greenland or face the consequences, saying that NATO owes it to the US to grant it full rights to the Arctic island.
In a speech to the World Economic Forum in Davos, after prompting days of transatlantic tensions over his plans, Trump said that he was seeking “immediate negotiations” on acquiring the sovereign Danish territory for national security reasons.
Bloomberg's David Gura joins to discuss on Bloomberg Intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He Won’t Use Force Over Greenland, Seeks Negotiations

description: US Supreme Court justices suggested they are wary of President Donald Trump’s effort to fire Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook over unproven mortgage-fraud allegations, saying the move could upend the Fed’s independence and rattle markets. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Supreme Court Appears Wary of Trump Bid to Fire Fed’s Cook

description: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam discusses whether enough has been done to address Hezbollah’s disarmament and the pathway toward restoring the state’s monopoly over arms, the implications of developments in Iran for Lebanon and the risk of renewed conflict with Israel. He also addresses negotiations with the IMF on banking reform and whether the country’s gold reserves should ever be sold. He spoke with Joumanna Bercetche on the sidelines of the 2026 World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Lebanon PM Salam on Disarmament, Iran, IMF Reforms

author: Zoe Tillman
description: Here are some key takeaways from the hearing Wednesday at the US Supreme Court over President Donald Trump’s effort to fire Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook over mortgage-fraud allegations she’s denied:
title: Key Takeaways for Supreme Court Hearing on Fed Governor Firing

description:
National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett says President Donald Trump will be making a “big” housing announcement soon as part of a “really ambitious” economic agenda. Hassett also says nothing has been finalized on who will replace Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. Hassett speaks to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern at World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
title: NEC's Hassett Teases 'Big' Housing Announcement From Trump

author: John Bowker
description: Lebanon has been asked by the International Monetary Fund to amend a proposed law to allow depositors to recover funds trapped in the banking system, Prime Minister Nawaf Salam said.
title: Lebanon’s PM Says IMF Asked for Changes to New Bank-Deposit Law

author: Patrick Van Oosterom, Annmarie Hordern, Sarah Jacob
description: Dutch Prime Minister Dick Schoof advocated for finding a diplomatic solution to resolve a dispute over additional tariffs that US president Donald Trump threatened to impose on several European countries if he can’t take over control of Greenland.
title: Dutch PM Urges Diplomatic Efforts to Resolve US Tariff Threats

author: Nacha Cattan
description: The Trump administration plans to buy a warehouse linked to billionaire investor Carl Icahn for Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations, stirring opposition in a small town in New York’s Hudson Valley.
title: ICE Faces Resistance Buying NY Warehouse Linked to Carl Icahn

author: Joe Mayes, Ellen Milligan
description: UK Business and Trade Secretary Peter Kyle sowed confusion over Britain’s stance on a customs union with the EU, saying Britain should consider the notion, a position in direct opposition to his governing Labour Party’s election promises.
title: UK Minister Sows Confusion With Softer EU Customs Union Line

author: Patrick Clark
description: President Donald Trump took aim at single-family landlords during a speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos, promising to prevent the US from becoming a nation of renters even as he apologized to investors in the properties.
title: Trump Offers Tepid Apology to Corporate Landlords He’s Targeting

description: Salesforce CEO and co-founder Marc Benioff talks about the dangers of unregulated artificial intelligence, how the technology can impact teens, and what President Trump can do to promote American businesses. Benioff speaks to Bloomberg's Emily Chang World Economic Forum 2026 in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Benioff Says AI Regulation Needs to Be Taken Seriously

author: Greg Stohr
description: US Supreme Court justices suggested they are wary of President Donald Trump’s effort to fire Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook over unproven mortgage-fraud allegations, saying the move could upend the Fed’s independence and rattle markets.
title: Supreme Court Appears Wary of Trump Bid to Fire Fed’s Cook

author: Katherine Burton, Sridhar Natarajan, Jaehyun Eom
description: Archegos Capital Management founder Bill Hwang is seeking a presidential pardon for his conviction in a high-profile Wall Street fraud case over the collapse of his $36 billion family office, which scorched banks and helped topple Credit Suisse Group AG.
title: Bill Hwang Seeks Pardon for Fraud That Cost Banks $10 Billion

author: Emma Sanchez
description: Halliburton Co. is ready to quickly restart operations in Venezuela once it obtains US government approval and some sort of payment protections, said Chief Executive Officer Jeff Miller.
title: Halliburton Sees Quick Return to Venezuela Upon US  Green Light

author: Laura Dhillon Kane, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: US President Donald Trump accused Mark Carney of ingratitude for American military protection, firing back after the Canadian leader used a Davos stage to urge mid-sized nations to band together against aggressive superpowers.
title: Trump Says Canada ‘Lives Because of the US’ After Carney Rebukes Washington

description: President Donald Trump says raising interest rates keeps the US from being successful during a speech at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Should Pay Lowest Interest Rate of Any Country

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump said that the US would not “become a nation of renters,” touting a handful of measures his administration is taking to address affordability concerns during a speech in Switzerland that largely focused on his interest in acquiring Greenland.
title: Trump Vows US Won’t Become ‘Nation of Renters’ in Davos Speech

description: President Trump said the US is seeking immediate negotiations to acquire Greenland, “but won’t use force” at the World Economic Forum on Wednesday. This is the second time the president has spoken before the conference (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He ‘Won’t Use Force’ to Take Greenland

description: President Donald Trump says he'll be making an announcement to replace "terrible" Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell in the "not-too-distant future" during a speech at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He'll Announce New Fed Chair Soon

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump upped the pressure on Europe to cede control of Greenland or face the consequences, saying that NATO owes it to the US to grant it full rights to the Arctic territory.
title: Trump Tells Europe and NATO to Hand Over Greenland - Or Else

description: Palestinian Authority Prime Minister Mohammad Mustafa said he seeks progress towards sovereignty amid a fragile ceasefire with Israel and President Donald Trump's plan for a so-called Board of Peace. He spoke with World Economic Forum Managing Director Mirek Dušek at the event in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Palestinian Authority PM Mustafa on Sovereignty

author: Jorge Valero
description: A trade deal between the US and European Union is on hold after the European Parliament decided to freeze a ratification vote in response to President Donald Trump’s escalating threats to seize Greenland.
title: EU Freezes US Trade Deal Approval Over Greenland Threats

description:
President Donald Trump says the US will not use the military to take Greenland. 
“People thought I would use force. I don’t have to use force. I don’t want to use force. I won’t use force,” he said during a speech at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Won't Use Force to Take Greenland

author: Dan Williams
description: Israel says its new laser defense system is being expanded this year for use on wheeled vehicles and helicopters, with an airborne version capable of shooting down ballistic missiles expected within a decade.
title: Israel Says Laser Defense System Is Going Mobile This Year

description: Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook and attorney Abbe Lowell arrive at the Supreme Court in Washington on Jan. 21. Photographer: Mark Schiefelbein/AP Photo
title: US Tells Supreme Court Trump Has Discretion to Fire Fed Official

author: Patricia Laya
description: The abrupt fall of Alex Saab, a longtime fixture of Nicolás Maduro’s regime, lays bare the fractures in Venezuela’s ruling party and how Delcy Rodríguez is reallocating power.
title: Maduro Fixer’s Fall Signals Power Shift in Rodriguez’s Venezuela

author: Michael Nienaber
description: Germany accused Russia of committing war crimes in Ukraine as Moscow’s forces pound the war-battered nation’s energy infrastructure, leaving vast parts of Kyiv and other communities without heating and water in frigid temperatures.
title: Germany Accuses Russia of War Crimes Over Winter Attacks on Kyiv

description:
President Donald Trump makes his way to Davos for the World Economic Forum, despite an initial delay in his flight. Global leaders have been voicing concerns over Washington's designs for Greenland and tariffs. Meanwhile, Japan's Finance Minister calms bond markets as politicians gear up for a snap election and the BOJ prepares for its next rate decision on Friday. A tentative recovery in US stock futures lost steam as traders await President Donald Trump’s address at Davos to hear whether he would ratchet down days of tensions with Europe over Greenland. 

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Donald Goes to Davos, Global Equities Stay Red | The Opening Trade 1/21/2026

author: Hadriana Lowenkron, Skylar Woodhouse
description: President Donald Trump hailed his policies as ushering in an American economic boom, and said his agenda offered an example for Europe to follow as he opened an address to the world’s business and political elite in Davos on Wednesday.
title: Trump Hails His Economic Policies as Example to Europe at Davos

description:
US Senator Thom Tillis, the North Carolina Republican who sits on the powerful Senate Banking Committee, discusses why he's opposed to any nominees by President Donald Trump to the Fed and Trump's threats to take over Greenland. He spoke to Bloomberg Surveillance on the sidelines of the 2026 World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Senator Thom Tillis on Opposition to Trump Fed Picks

author: William Horobin
description: France has postponed the first meeting of Group of Seven finance officials under its presidency of the club, at which US President Donald Trump’s tariff threats were expected to be discussed.
title: France Delays G-7 Finance Meeting to Discuss US Tariff Threats

author: Tooba Khan
description: Pakistan said it has accepted President Donald Trump’s invitation to join Board of Peace to support implementation of the Gaza peace plan.
title: Pakistan to Join Board of Peace to Support Gaza Peace Plan

description: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon explains why US President Donald Trump’s call for credit-card companies to cap the interest rates they charge would be an "economic disaster." He speaks during an interview with Economist Editor-in-Chief Zanny Minton Beddoes at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: JPMorgan CEO Dimon Says Credit Card Cap Would Be 'Economic Disaster'

description: Norway’s $2.1 trillion sovereign wealth fund has no reason to pull back investments from the US now, Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg says in an interview on Bloomberg TV. He also discusses Greenland's crisis, NATO and Ukraine on the sidelines of the 2026 World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stoltenberg on Norway Wealth Fund, Greenland, Ukraine

author: Chad Thomas, Heidi Taksdal Skjeseth
description: Norway’s Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg said he sees no reason for the country’s $2.1 trillion sovereign wealth fund to exit US markets now amid geopolitical turbulence that threatens to split the transatlantic alliance.
title: Norway’s Stoltenberg Sees No Reason for Wealth Fund to Exit US

author: Jorge Valero, Max Ramsay
description: The European Parliament voted to submit a landmark trade deal with South American countries for judicial review by the bloc’s top judges, risking further delays to the Mercosur pact, which has already been a quarter century in the making.
title: EU Lawmakers Send Mercosur Deal for Legal Test at Top Court

author: Gaspard Sebag
description: French far-right leader Marine Le Pen faced a raft of questions in court about why staffers working for her as leader of the far right National Rally were paid for by European funds in her appeal of an election ban that threatens her presidential ambitions.
title: Le Pen Testifies on Staffers Working for Her Party Paid But by the EU

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump intends to expand his domestic travel ahead of November’s midterm elections as he looks to tout his economic agenda and reverse poor marks from American voters.
title: Trump to Ramp Up Travel Before Midterms to Tout Economic Message

author: Zoe Schneeweiss, Jenny Leonard
description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde abruptly walked out of an invitation-only sit-down dinner in Davos after US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick started laying into Europe, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: ECB’s Lagarde Left Davos Dinner After Lutnick Slammed Europe

author: Alex Wickham
description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer accused Donald Trump of trying to strong-arm the UK on security issues, in the latest sign of how the US president’s demands on Greenland are fracturing the transatlantic alliance.
title: Starmer Hits Out at Trump, Vowing Not Cave to Greenland Pressure

author: Ott Ummelas
description: Norway’s defense minister said the strategic importance of the energy-rich nation’s polar archipelago is rising due to growing great-power rivalry in the Arctic.
title: Norway Defense Chief Flags Increased Tension in Svalbard Gap

author: Anthony Halpin
description: Russia seized a record amount of assets last year but is struggling to profit from their sale, with the failed auction of a major Moscow airport underscoring the challenges the state faces in topping up its coffers with the proceeds.
title: Russia Struggles to Sell Seized Assets to Bolster Wartime Budget

author: Chad Thomas, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump’s address in Davos is set to start at its scheduled time, according to the World Economic Forum, despite his flight to Switzerland being delayed by a mechanical issue.
title: Trump’s Davos Speech to Start on Time Despite Flight Delay

author: Ben Sills
description: US envoy Steve Witkoff said he and Jared Kushner will travel to Russia on Thursday for talks with President Vladimir Putin on the latest proposals for a peace plan to end the war in Ukraine.
title: US Envoys to Meet Putin for New Talks on Ukraine, Witkoff Says

description: US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff says there will be discussions on Greenland at the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland. Speaking to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern, he adds Denmark cannot defend Greenland "in an adequate way" as compared to how the US can. He also talks about Ukraine peace talks and says he will travel to Moscow on Thursday with US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner. He speaks on Bloomberg Television.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Witkoff on Greenland Security, Ukraine Talks, Iran

author: Alan Crawford
description: As the US president takes a wrecking ball to the world order, EU leaders hope to dissuade him in Switzerland.
title: Trump Steps Into a Transatlantic Rift at Davos

author: Fabienne Kinzelmann, Bastian Benrath-Wright
description: Talks on the details of the trade deal between Switzerland and the US are expected to start in the first half of February in Bern, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: US-Swiss Talks on Final Trade Deal to Start in Bern in February

author: Greg Stohr, Amara Omeokwe, Catarina Saraiva
description: The US Supreme Court so far has helped shield the Federal Reserve from President Donald Trump’s efforts to seize control. An argument Wednesday will test just how committed the court is to the Fed’s independence.
title: Trump’s Power Over Fed Tested as Supreme Court Hears Cook Case

author: Andrea Palasciano, Samy Adghirni, Sanne Wass, Skylar Woodhouse, Saleha Mohsin
description: The US has denounced a French push to hold a NATO-led military exercise in Greenland, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warning European nations against sending troops to the island as President Donald Trump threatens to seize it.
title: US Pushes Back on French Calls for NATO Drills in Greenland

author: Andrew Rosati
description: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is gaining ground on President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in Brazil’s looming election, solidifying his position as the main opposition candidate ahead of the October vote.
title: Bolsonaro’s Son Emerges as Main Challenger to Lula in New Poll

description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer discusses the trade relationship with the European Union in light of geopolitical tensions over Greenland. He also talks about how the US is going to look at Chinese investments in Canada, as well as tracking of transshipped goods. Greer speaks to Bloomberg’s Annmarie Hordern at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.
title: USTR Greer on Trade, Greenland, China Investments

author: Jorge Valero
description: The European Union is ready to strike back at Donald Trump over his tariff threats as he seeks to take Greenland, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said, toughening her rhetoric against the US president.
title: EU ‘Fully Prepared’ to Hit Back Over Trump’s Greenland Tariffs

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia.

On today's show, President Donald Trump’s trip to the World Economic Forum in Davos had a rough start, after the government plane he was flying on was forced to return to Joint Base Andrews in Maryland shortly after departure because of a mechanical issue.

Trump expressed confidence that the European Union would continue to invest in the US even if he imposed new tariffs related to his quest to take control of Greenland, a proposal that has angered leaders on the continent.

Netflix fell postmarket after issuing a cautious outlook, citing higher program spending and costs tied to closing its Warner deal.

Today's guests: South African Reserve Bank Governor Lesetja Kganyago & International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Heads To Davos: Air Force One Issue Delays Start Of Trip | Daybreak Europe 01/21/2026

author: Philip Heijmans, Rieka Rahadiana
description: Singapore’s main opposition party said it will not nominate a replacement leader of the opposition after Pritam Singh was stripped of the title last week by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong following a conviction for lying to a parliamentary committee.
title: Singapore Workers’ Party Rejects Leader of Opposition Role

author: Skylar Woodhouse, Saleha Mohsin
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent cautioned European nations against ramping up their military presence on Greenland and assailed France over calls to conduct a NATO exercise as European leaders brace for President Donald Trump’s arrival at Davos.
title: Bessent Cautions Allies Over Military Missions in Greenland

author: Skylar Woodhouse
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Deutsche Bank AG Chief Executive Officer Christian Sewing called to dismiss a report from one of the German lender’s analysts that had suggested European investors may dump US assets.
title: Bessent Says Deutsche Bank CEO Called to Dismiss Analyst Report

description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he is “not sure” why Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell would support Governor Lisa Cook over unproven mortgage fraud allegations. He adds that Powell is “politicizing” the central bank. Bessent speaks to reporters from USA House at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. (Source: USA House Davos)
title: Powell Is ‘Politicizing the Fed,’ Bessent Says

author: Shruti Srivastava, Jorge Valero
description: The European Union and India are nearing a “historic” trade agreement, the bloc’s chief said, as both sides look to strengthen ties and bolster their economies in the face of rising tariff threats from US President Donald Trump.
title: EU Sees ‘Historic’ India Trade Pact in Wake of Trump’s Threats

author: Samy Adghirni, Sanne Wass
description: France will request that NATO carry out a military exercise in Greenland in a bid to boost the region’s security.
title: France Seeks NATO Exercise in Greenland as Tensions Mount

author: Erica Yokoyama, Akemi Terukina
description: The leader of Japan’s largest labor union group urged Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s government to stabilize currencies and prices, as inflation continues to hit households and workers.
title: Japan Union Head Calls on Government to Stabilize FX, Prices

author: Soo-Hyang Choi
description: Former South Korean Prime Minister Han Duck-soo was sentenced to 23 years in prison, a term significantly longer than prosecutors had sought, for his role in an insurrection tied to former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s failed attempt to impose martial law in 2024.
title: Ex-South Korea Premier Han Gets 23 Years For Martial Law Role

author: Jonathan Tirone, Joumanna Bercetche
description: The United Nations nuclear watchdog sees Iran in a “very fragile” state amid stalled diplomatic efforts and nationwide protests that convulsed the country earlier this month.
title: UN Nuclear Watchdog Says Iran Is in a ‘Very Fragile’ State

author: Tom Rees
description: UK inflation accelerated for the first time in five months, a pickup that’s expected to prove temporary with government measures set to dampen price pressures in the spring.
title: UK Posts 3.4% Inflation Rate in Pickup Expected to Be Temporary

author: Zoe Schneeweiss, Jan-Henrik Foerster
description: Larry Fink, the interim co-chief of the World Economic Forum, is openly musing about a venue change for the flagship event that would take the annual January meeting outside of Switzerland.
title: Larry Fink Ponders Moving WEF Meetings From Davos to Dublin or Detroit

author: Arun Devnath
description: Bangladesh’s economy is poised for a quick rebound following next month’s national election provided the transition of power in the South Asian nation remains peaceful, according to the head of the country’s central bank.
title: Bangladesh Central Bank Chief Says Economy to Rebound After Vote

author: Mihir Mishra, Sudhi Ranjan Sen
description: India plans to launch over 50 spy satellites and add night-time imaging to enhance its national security capabilities, people familiar with the matter said, after New Delhi encountered surveillance blind spots during a border conflict last year with neighbor Pakistan.
title: India Beefing Up Space-Based Surveillance After Border Conflict

author: Grace Sihombing
description: Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo was summoned to the presidential palace Wednesday to discuss policy coordination as the country’s currency hits a record low, a rare meeting held just hours before the central bank is set to decide on interest rates.
title: Bank Indonesia Governor Summoned to Palace In Rare Move Before Rate Decision

author: Andreo Calonzo
description: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte is facing new accusations of plunder and graft from a civil group, amid growing signs that the nation’s politics is headed into a new bout of internecine feuding.
title: Sara Duterte Faces New Complaint as Philippine Political Battles Grow

author: Lucy White
description: With everyone from Mark Carney down declaring the death of the rules-based international order, Nigel Farage wasn’t going to pass up a spot at the wake.
title: Farage Readies to Stir the Pot at Davos Among the Elite He Scorned

author: Soo-Hyang Choi, Yoolim Lee
description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung downplayed US threats of punishing tariffs on foreign-made chips, while reaffirming his commitment to existing trade agreements.
title: South Korea’s President Lee Downplays US Chip Tariff Threats

author: Akemi Terukina, Sakura Murakami
description: Japan’s government and central bank must take a firm stand on surging yields, the head of a small but influential opposition party said, a day after longer-term Japanese bond yields surged to record-highs over fiscal fears.
title: Japan’s Government, BOJ Need Firm Stand on Yields, Tamaki Says

author: Soo-Hyang Choi
description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said North Korea continues to produce nuclear material at a pace that could allow it to add up to 20 nuclear weapons a year, underscoring concerns that Pyongyang has no intention of slowing its nuclear program.
title: North Korea Can Build 20 Nukes a Year, South Korea’s Lee Says

author: Catherine Lucey, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump’s plane reversed course and returned to Joint Base Andrews shortly after departing for the World Economic Forum in Davos on Tuesday night because of a mechanical issue.
title: Air Force One Returns to US Over ‘Minor’ Electrical Problem

author: Chris Strohm, Jimmy Jenkins
description: The embattled interim US attorney in eastern Virginia, Lindsey Halligan, is leaving her post, according to US Attorney General Pam Bondi.
title: Virginia US Attorney Lindsey Halligan to Leave Post, Bondi Says

author: Oscar Medina
description: The Colombian government unveiled a draft decree that would push pension funds to invest more heavily in the domestic economy.
title: Colombia Moves to Cap Pension Funds’ Overseas Holdings at 30%

author: Katy O'Donnell, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order Tuesday seeking to advance his effort to ban large institutional investors from buying single-family homes, before a trip to the World Economic Forum in Davos where he’s expected to lay out his efforts to address affordability concerns.
title: Trump Signs Order Targeting Institutional Housing Investors

description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Leon Panetta, former US Secretary of Defense, discusses the global implications of President Trump's Greenland tariff threats. Euan Rellie, BDA Partners Co-Founder & Managing Partner, on Trump's rhetoric impacting markets, and Meredith Crowley, University of Cambridge Professor of Economics, on how Europe might respond to Trump's Greenland threats. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Brings Greenland Fight to Davos | Balance of Power: Late Edition 01/20/2026

author: Matthew Malinowski, Carolina Gonzalez, Antonia Mufarech
description: Chile’s President-elect José Antonio Kast unveiled his cabinet on Tuesday night, naming top adviser and anti-regulation crusader Jorge Quiroz as his finance chief while backing off from a cost-cutting plan to reduce the number of ministers.
title: Chile President-Elect Kast Names Cabinet With Quiroz as Finance Chief

author: Isabel Reynolds
description: A Japanese court is set to hand down its verdict on the man accused in the fatal 2022 shooting of former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe —- a crime that horrified the nation and sparked controversy over the ruling party’s ties to a religious group.
title: Japan Court Set to Deliver Verdict in Killing of Former PM Abe

author: Ellen Milligan
description: The UK is seeking to advance talks to sell warships to Denmark amid increasing threats posed by Russia in the North Atlantic and as transatlantic ties are put under strain by Donald Trump’s efforts to take control of Greenland.
title: UK Touts Warships to Denmark Amid Russian Threat in High North
